text: Main courses Macro-economy,Micro-economy,Economitrics,International Trade,International Trade PracticeMoney and Banking,Public Finance Principles of Accounting,Principles of Statistics,Economics of Development. Fees Health Insurance: 600 Yuan/year Medical Examination: 535 Yuan/year Residence Permit: 800 Yuan/year Living Cost (food): 1000 Yuan/Month Books: It depends on the program. Accommodation Fee: Hostel (single room A): 1200 Yuan/Mon Hostel (single room B): 900 Yuan/Mon Hostel (single room D): 4000 Yuan/year Student dorm (4 students persons share one room): 2500 Yuan/year Application time: March1-September 15 each year Duration: 4years (beginning at September each year) Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, and career consultation. Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Economics Future Career The graduates can work in the International trade transportation, insurance, customs clearance etc agencies, specialized foreign-trade corporations, and import and export department's of foreign-owned enterprises.
